The '''Omicron Hunter-21X''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] seen in use during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Midnite Forsberg]] was known to [[Pilot/Legends|pilote]] a Hunter-21X after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66853&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dantooine System}}</ref>
